name: SaunaLife GL6 6-Person Outdoor Sauna Kit | Garden Luxury Series
description: Garden Luxury-Series Outdoor DIY Sauna Kit, Thermo-Spruce, up to 6 Persons The SaunaLife Garden Luxury-Series Model GL6 sauna cabin demonstrates outstanding quality and meticulous craftsmanship throughout. Its modern linear design is highlighted by contrasting exterior finishes and features a wrap-around eaves and porch, offering a welcoming recessed look. Large full-front glass windows and a side door fill the space with natural light and provide clear, unobstructed views, amplifying the sense of openness in this luxurious setting. Premium-Quality Materials The exterior features robust 1.57” thick thermally treated spruce, which not only highlights the wood’s natural grain but also exceeds the durability of standard timber by offering superior resistance to moisture, decay, and fungi. The front showcases a full-height tempered bronze glass window and door, ensuring clear, unobstructed views. Inside, the two-tiered benches are smooth, free of knots, and ergonomically shaped to conform to your body, providing optimal comfort. Elegantly Illuminated The SaunaLife GL6 features recessed LED lighting under the eaves that softly brightens the porch and entryway, guiding you safely to your sauna retreat. Inside, indirect LED lights, adjustable via Wi-Fi or handheld remote, provide a gentle, even illumination that accentuates the natural warmth and grain of the wooden interior. Built to Withstand Any Weather The Model GL6 is designed to withstand all weather conditions. Its thick, durable Thermo-Spruce walls and tempered glass front effectively retain heat, while the roofing and metal flashing ensure excellent water drainage, keeping the interior dry and protected. Pro Results in Two Days SaunaLife leads the industry in home sauna solutions and DIY sauna kits. Clear instructions, precise craftsmanship, and thoughtful design enable you to build a backyard sauna with professional-quality outcomes. All necessary materials and fasteners are provided, allowing two individuals with moderate DIY skills to complete the assembly and achieve expert results within two days. The GL6 Black includes outdoor black paint for customer application after delivery. The paint is recommended to be reapplied annually as needed to maintain the finish. Applying the paint after delivery allows for a smooth, even finish and helps avoid scratches or nicks that can occur during LTL freight shipping.
